text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—My. I thought I heard someone call for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Three Goddesses. Did you beckon me here? 
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Relying on divine favor is not my 
creed. 
Yet—once all mortal effort has been 
exhausted, 
what remains is solely in heaven's hands.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I do not pray for victory. 
I ask only this—grant that I may be 
strong.
